title: Matthew 25:14-30
subtitle: 33rd Sunday in Ordinary Time · Prv 31:10-13, 19-20, 30-31; 1 Thes 5:1-6; Mt 25:14-30
text: In the parable of the talents, the servant who buried his master's money was not condemned for losing it, but for being too afraid to use it. God gives each of us gifts according to our ability and asks us to put them to work. Today is also the World Day of the Poor, a fitting day to spend a gift on someone in need.
